purpose: Allow prospective real-market evaluation when automated late-odds capture is difficult by freezing model-side candidate tickets and acceptable odds bands before the decision moment, then accepting a human-observed late odds value as market evidence.
principle: The research object is the frozen pre-race decision card, not an actual wager.
pre_race_lock_required: model probability or model score used to rank the combo
predeclared acceptable odds interval or minimum odds threshold
decision rule such as SHADOW_BUY / SHADOW_PASS
all PRE feature provenance and timestamps
card creation timestamp and immutable hash/commit provenance

required_fields: whether result was known at observation
late_market_observation.preferred_timing: as close to betting close as practical while still pre-result
late_market_observation.not_required: exact T-3 capture for every race
late_market_observation.rule: Use the observed value only to apply the already-frozen odds-band rule; do not alter model probability, combo selection, threshold, or feature set after seeing the odds.

shadow_decision.meaning: counterfactual research decision only; no actual-money execution is required or authorized

anti_hindsight: combo and odds band must be locked before late-odds observation
no changing odds band after seeing late odds
no dropping losing shadow decisions after outcome
no adding winning combos after outcome
outcome joins only after the decision card and late-market observation are locked or marked unresolved

evaluation.economics: NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_PROTOCOL; no ROI/model promotion or real-money betting claim

compatibility: This protocol complements, not replaces, source-timestamped multi-snapshot market collection. Automated snapshots remain valuable when safely available.
